speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Joan has the children at the gate. Let them go ahead. I want ten paces of a path that is not a pie.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They can have the gate. I am behind thee. The limes are the whole of the news I am willing to have.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Then have them quietly. The Cross is not far, and I am not arriving as a procession with a commentary.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No commentary. Dinner, and then we are there.
